name: Fade Studio
tagline: Sharp cuts. Clean fades. Zero rush.

services.name: Classic Haircut
services.description: Scissor or clipper cut, wash and styling.

services.name: Skin Fade
services.description: Fade down to the skin, blended by hand, finished with styling.

services.name: Beard Trim & Shape
services.description: Beard shaping with clippers and razor line-up.

services.name: Hot Towel Shave
services.description: Traditional straight-razor shave with hot towels and aftershave balm.

services.name: Haircut + Beard Combo
services.description: Any haircut plus a full beard trim and shape.

policies.booking: Appointments are recommended. Booking requests through this bot are confirmed by the team.
policies.walk_ins: Walk-ins are welcome when a chair is free, but booked clients have priority.
policies.cancellation: Please cancel or reschedule at least 12 hours in advance.
policies.late_arrival: If you are more than 15 minutes late, we may need to reschedule.
policies.payment: We accept cash, card and MB WAY.

faq.question: Do you have parking?
faq.answer: There is no private parking, but there is a public car park (Parque Trindade) about 5 minutes away on foot.

faq.question: Do you sell hair products?
faq.answer: Yes, we sell pomades, clays, beard oils and shampoos at the front desk.

faq.question: Do you offer gift cards?
faq.answer: Yes, gift cards are available in any amount from 15 EUR, in store only.
